content_sections.heading: GMDW&SB Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. GJB/GEN/12/Pt.I/2022/02 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download GMDW&SB notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post-Graduation in Commerce / Accounting / Finance or equivalent from a recognised university; minimum 10 (ten) years of experience in accounts, budgeting procedures, taxation, audit, and financial management. Experience: Minimum 10 (ten) years of experience in accounts, budgeting procedures, taxation, audit, and financial management. Age limit: Maximum 55 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Strong working skills in Government accounting, budgeting, audit compliance, contract finance, statutory taxation and computerized accounting systems Proven ability to advise management and supervise finance and accounts functions Desirable: Professional Qualifications such as CA/CMA/MBA (Finance), or equivalent Experience in externally aided projects or projects under Central Government / State Government / Autonomous Body / PSU or other Government Agency

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GMDW&SB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after the scheduled reporting time will not be entertained Canvassing of any kind shall lead to disqualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consolidated fixed remuneration determined and mutually agreed on the basis of qualifications, experience and competency; applicable taxes as per prevailing law. Engagement for eleven months initially, may be renewed on the basis of performance and requirement of the post Employer may terminate with 30-day notice or one month's remuneration in advance Employee may resign with one month's prior notice or refund of one month remuneration Employer may terminate at any time for misconduct, misreporting, unsatisfactory performance or negligence in duty

content_sections.heading: How Will GMDW&SB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Interview at 11.00 AM on 08-12-2026; reporting 10 A.M. to 11 A.M. Documents verified with originals

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: All original documents One set of self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates Proof of age and valid photo ID Copy of updated Resume/CV with recent passport-size photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMDW&SB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report at the Conference Hall of GMDW&SB, Kharghuli, Ghy - 04 on 08-12-2026 between 10 A.M. and 11 A.M. Bring all original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, proof of age and valid photo ID. Bring a copy of updated Resume/CV with recent passport-size photograph.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA for attending the interview Authority reserves the right to postpone or cancel the interview without assigning reasons All corrigendum/addendum/announcement will be published on the website only ToR is draft indicative; MD may change it at any stage of the recruitment process
